about: A product designer who also prototypes: design tickets in one project, dev work (features, spikes) and design QA in another.

views.label: Design
views.jql: project = {{design}} AND (assignee = currentUser() OR reporter = currentUser()) AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -14d) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Features
views.jql: project = {{dev}} AND assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype not in ("{{spike_type}}", {{subtask_types}}) AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -14d) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Prototypes
views.jql: project = {{dev}} AND issuetype = "{{spike_type}}" AND (assignee = currentUser() OR reporter = currentUser()) AND (statusCategory != Done OR updated >= -30d) ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Design QA
views.jql: project = {{dev}} AND (issuetype in ({{qa_types}}) OR summary ~ "{{qa_title}}") AND (reporter = currentUser() OR assignee = currentUser()) AND updated >= -45d ORDER BY updated DESC

views.label: Recent
views.jql: issue in issueHistory() ORDER BY lastViewed DESC
